gaps.GET /v1/context-graph/git-sources: lists the discovery repo sources bound into the context graph as git sources, each with how many repositories are mapped and when it last synced
gaps.POST /v1/context-graph/git-sources: binds a discovery repo source as a git source (a settings_relax step-up, audited); nothing is read until a repository is mapped
gaps.DELETE /v1/context-graph/git-sources/:gi: unbinds a git source (audited), removing its mappings, repositories, pull requests, nodes, edges and scopes
gaps.GET /v1/context-graph/git-sources/:gitSo: lists a git source's repository-to-project mappings, with when each repository was last seen or went missing
gaps.PUT /v1/context-graph/git-sources/:gitSo: maps (or remaps) one repository to a project (a settings_relax step-up, audited); a remap re-scopes its nodes in the same transaction
gaps.DELETE /v1/context-graph/git-sources/:gi: unmaps one repository (audited), removing its facts and nodes
gaps.POST /v1/context-graph/git-sources/:gitS: reads the mapped repositories and their pull requests from the provider (read only) and writes them into the graph, audited
